description: Pulse Wave 6.1.10 — Official Adobe CC Design 1 App Icon with uncompromised 'Pw' typography and integrated precision digital audio waveform baseline, dynamic UI sync, Apple Music Light Mode, and cute animated Day/Night switch.

changelog.title: Official Adobe CC Music App Icon (Design 1)
items: Authentic Adobe Typography: Clean, bold, uncompromised 'Pw' typography inside a flat squircle container (#14141D) with a thin pastel lavender border.
Precision Audio Wave Baseline: Integrated razor-sharp digital music frequency pulse wave directly below the letters, unmistakably identifying Pulse Wave as a professional music app.
Full Adaptive Icon Suite: Baked across all mipmap densities (mdpi to xxxhdpi) in 5 soft pastel colorways (Soft Lavender, Soft Sky, Soft Sage, Soft Rose, and Porcelain Light).
Android 13+ Themed Icons: Updated vector monochrome icon (ic_launcher_mono.xml) with the Adobe container, Pw glyphs, and audio wave baseline for native launcher theming.
In-App Dynamic Logo: Responsive Compose PulseWaveLogo component with live preview in Theme Settings and About screen.

changelog.title: Apple Music Light Mode & Fluid Transitions
items: Apple Light Mode Surfaces: Clean, luminous porcelain and snow-white surfaces (#F8F9FA, #FFFFFF) with crisp slate outlines and typography.
Cute Animated Theme Switch: Smiling golden sun with rotating sunbeams and floating cloud vs sleepy crescent moon with blushing cheeks and twinkling stars.
Fluid Theme Morphing: Smooth physics-based spring color interpolation across all surfaces, cards, and text when toggling between Day and Night.

changelog.title: Butter-Smooth Apple Music iOS 18 Startup
items: Hardware-accelerated native splash exit animation: seamlessly zooms the Adobe 'Pw' squircle (1.0x to 1.15x) and softly dissolves into the Home screen in 320ms via PathInterpolator curve.
Zero dropped frames: removed heavy Compose infinite ripple loops and double-scale transformations that previously contested with database initialization.
